name: demo-video-maker
description: Turn screen recordings into a polished product demo video: trim each step, add smooth zoom-ins on the control being used, callouts, subtitles and a title card, and render an MP4 plus SRT. After a product update, replace one segment's recording and only that segment is re-rendered. Uses the ffmpeg installed on your computer; no API keys.

description_i18n.en: Turn screen recordings into a polished product demo video: trim each step, add smooth zoom-ins on the control being used, callouts, subtitles and a title card, and render an MP4 plus SRT. After a product update, replace one segment's recording and only that segment is re-rendered. Uses the ffmpeg installed on your computer; no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把产品录屏做成演示视频：每一步剪出入点，在正在操作的地方平滑放大，加说明文字、字幕和片头，渲染成 MP4 和 SRT 字幕。产品更新后只需替换其中一段录屏，只重渲染这一段。使用电脑上已安装的 ffmpeg，无需 API 密钥。

ffmpegPath.title: ffmpeg 路径（可选）
ffmpegPath.description: 可选。ffmpeg 可执行文件的完整路径。默认在 PATH 和 /opt/homebrew/bin、/usr/local/bin 中查找。

fontPath.title: 中文字体文件（可选）
fontPath.description: 可选。说明文字和片头使用的字体文件（.ttf/.otf/.ttc）。默认自动查找系统中文字体。
